title: Migrate remaining real represented-matrix norms
status_detail: Created by the human instruction `create these as tasks`. This records a proposed bounded extraction only; it does not activate implementation, change a public contract, or authorize protected execution.
objective: Migrate remaining real dense and sparse matrix-norm calculations in the public harmonic-oscillator and particle-in-a-box implementations to RepresentedMatrixNormAnalyzer while preserving retained numerical artifacts.
authorized_scope: After separate explicit activation, replace duplicated production-side real Frobenius, spectral, and maximum-entry calculations with the existing public represented-matrix norm ActionObject.
Remove campaign-local norm helpers only when their semantics exactly match the public analyzer.
Preserve quantity units, numerical ordering, serialization boundaries, source provenance, and retained harmonic-oscillator and particle-in-a-box numerical payloads.
completion_criteria: Applicable production-side real represented-matrix norm calculations use one public ActionObject without changing their declared semantics.
Retained artifacts remain byte-identical and newly authored payloads agree after the documented provenance boundary.
Focused software and numerical verification, strict typing, lint, documentation, checksum, and verifier-independence checks pass.
exclusions: Do not extend the norm API to complex matrices, vectors, batches, Fourier truncation, projector distances, or new normalization policies in this task.
Do not make independent verifiers import the production analyzer.
No protected calculation, scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, release, publication, or automatic successor activation is authorized.
